name: Orum Therapeutics, Inc.
summary: Orum Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the discovery and development of novel therapeutic solutions for both cancer and immune system conditions. The firm specializes in creating degrader-antibody conjugates, an innovative class of drugs that merges traditional antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) technology with targeted protein degradation. Their flagship product candidate, ORM-1153, functions as a GSPT1 protein degrader, specifically engineered to address hematologic malignancies. Orum Therapeutics was established in 2016 and operates out of Daejeon, South Korea.
